# PropAI Pulse

PropAI Pulse is a real-time real estate intelligence platform for Mumbai. It organizes live property inventory, requirements, and market signals across the city's core micro-markets.

## High-Level Purpose
- Real-time off-market property intelligence.
- Direct broker connection for active listings.
- Coverage of Mumbai micro-markets (Bandra, Worli, Powai, etc.).
- Intelligence mesh summarizing active market data into clean property listings and locality signals.

## Key Entry Points
- Home: https://www.propai.live/
- Listings: https://www.propai.live/listings
- Insights: https://www.propai.live/insights
- Blog: https://www.propai.live/blog
- Broker Signup: https://www.propai.live/broker/signup

## Content available
- /insights - weekly market snapshots per Mumbai locality, auto-generated from live data.
- /locality/{slug} - live listings and requirements per locality.
- /blog - guides and analysis on Mumbai real estate market.
- /search - search all current listings by locality, BHK, and budget.

## Data freshness
- Locality pages: updated hourly.
- Market insights: published weekly on Mondays.
- Blog articles: published monthly.

## Data Structure
Property listings include:
- Title (Config: BHK + Typology)
- Locality (Mumbai micro-market)
- Price (INR)
- Features (Amenities, Floor, etc.)
- Broker contact action
